repairStatusEffects.Name: Repair the status effect list
repairStatusEffects.Hint: Foundry v14 keeps the status effect list as an object keyed by id. If another module turns it back into an array (which hides conditions from the Token HUD and breaks applying them), rebuild it and restore any dnd5e conditions that were lost. A warning is logged to the console when this happens.

alphabetizeHud.Name: Alphabetize Token HUD conditions
alphabetizeHud.Hint: Sort the status effect picker on the Token HUD alphabetically by name instead of the system's default order.

hudPinned.Name: Pin these conditions first
hudPinned.Hint: Status ids (comma or space separated) to keep at the top of the picker, before the alphabetical list. Default: dead. Leave blank for a purely alphabetical list.

hudLabels.Name: Show condition names on the Token HUD
hudLabels.Hint: Show each condition's name next to its icon in the Token HUD picker (per user).

hudColumns.Name: Token HUD picker columns
hudColumns.Hint: How many columns of named conditions to show in the picker (per user).

postConditions.Name: Post condition rules to chat
postConditions.Hint: When a condition is applied to a creature, post a chat card explaining what that condition does.

postRemovals.Name: Post when a condition ends
postRemovals.Hint: Also post a short line when a condition is removed from a creature.

postRiders.Name: Post rider conditions too
postRiders.Hint: Some conditions automatically add others (Unconscious also adds Prone). Enable this to post a card for the added condition as well.

conditionTextSource.Name: Condition rules text
conditionTextSource.Hint: Where the condition description comes from. The system's rules pages carry the full 2024 text and are used whenever available; the built-in text is a shorter SRD 5.2 summary.
conditionTextSource.System: System rules journal (falls back to built-in)

chatVisibility.Name: Chat card visibility
chatVisibility.Hint: Who sees the condition and Hunter's Mark chat cards.

animationsEnabled.Name: Animate conditions on tokens
animationsEnabled.Hint: Play a looping animation on a token while it has a condition. Uses Sequencer + JB2A when installed, otherwise Token Magic FX filters where configured.

animationConfig.Name: Condition animations
animationConfig.Label: Configure animations
animationConfig.Hint: Choose which animation (Sequencer database path or file) or Token Magic FX filter plays for each condition.

marks.Name: Hunter's Marks
marks.Hint: One per line as Name|color or Name|color|animation. Each line adds a '<Name>'s Mark' status effect to the Token HUD. Colors (for the icon): red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple, pink, white. The optional animation is a Sequencer database path such as jb2a.energy_strands.02.marker.green; without one the JB2A Hunter's Mark loop in the icon colour is used. Reload after changing.

marksExclusive.Name: One mark per hunter
marksExclusive.Hint: Applying a character's mark to a creature removes that character's mark from every other creature on the scene.

marksPostChat.Name: Announce marks in chat
marksPostChat.Hint: Post a short chat message when a Hunter's Mark is applied or removed.

marksAnimate.Name: Animate marks
marksAnimate.Hint: Play the Hunter's Mark animation on marked tokens (needs Sequencer + JB2A, or Token Magic FX).

AnimationConfig.Title: Condition Animations
AnimationConfig.Hint: JSON map of status id to animation. Each entry can have a "sequencer" block (file: a Sequencer database path such as jb2a.markers.poison.dark_green.02 or a direct file path; scale; offsetY in grid units; opacity; tint; belowToken) and/or a "tmfx" list of Token Magic FX filter parameters. Set an entry to null to disable it. Unknown entries are ignored.
AnimationConfig.InvalidJSON: The animation map is not valid JSON: {error}
AnimationConfig.NotObject: The animation map must be a JSON object keyed by status id.

Marks.Name: {name}'s Mark
Marks.Description: This creature is the quarry of {name}'s Hunter's Mark.
Marks.Unknown: No Hunter's Mark is configured for "{name}". Add it in the module settings.
Marks.NoTarget: Target or select a token first.
Marks.NoPermission: You don't have permission to modify {name}.
